MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON AUG-13-2019 IN 206 -- APPEARANCE BY LAUREN MEISEL, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF DE WU LI -- PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR TRIAL PREFERENCE IS DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. HOWEVER, THE COURT ORDERED THAT THE TRIAL DATE ON THIS MATTER IS SET FOR 12/9/19 AT 9:30 AM IN DEPT. 206. THE CASE MANAGEMENT SET FOR 10/2/19 IN DEPT. 610 IS VACATED. THE COURT STATED TO COUNSEL THAT JURY FEES MUST BE POSTED BY 2:00 PM IN PERSON OR 4:00 PM, IF TO BE SUBMITTED ELECTRONICALLY, FOR TRIAL BY JURY TO BE SET. OTHERWISE, IT WILL BE SET AS A COURT TRIAL. ALL DEADLINES ARE TO BE BASED ON THE 12/9/19 TRIAL DATE. ORDER SIGNED. JUDGE: GARRETT L. WONG; CLERK: JIROQUE; COURT REPORTER: MATTER NOT REPORTED. (206)
